title: Windows Claude launch wrapper
description: Objective: provide the missing physical Claude execution boundary required by Foundation Preview. Deliverable: a real Node/Windows runner wrapper that resolves and content-address-pins the installed Claude runtime closure, re-observes path/digest/version/capability/platform immediately before activation, consumes a one-use supervisor activation grant, acquires the OS-exclusive launch lock, starts Claude without a shell, registers/observes the process, captures bounded raw stdout/stderr/exit evidence, and cleans the whole process tree on cancel/failure. NOT in scope: daemon/store orchestration, verification commands, review, or canary fixtures. Depends on the committed supervisor/Claude observation surfaces; its real production consumer is the Durable Claude attempt dispatch task created in this breakdown. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/providers/claude/claude-launcher.ts, claude-launcher.js, claude-launcher.test.ts, and packages/runner/src/surface/claude-surface.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test && a plain-Node @moe/runner root import/launch smoke.
definitionOfDone: The wrapper resolves the installed runtime, hashes every declared closure entry, records the actual version/platform/pinning method, and returns typed UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED with stable launcher code/layer when any fact is missing or unverifiable.

No child process starts before runtime re-observation, activation-grant validation/consumption, and OS-exclusive launch-lock acquisition all succeed; each refusal asserts the exact production code and layer and proves zero spawn calls.

Launch uses an argument array with shell disabled and a bounded environment/cwd; Windows process-tree cleanup is awaited on success, cancellation, timeout, and thrown-error paths so no handle or child leaks.

Duplicate delivery either adopts the registered process or refuses before provider launch; a consumed/forged/wrong-wrapper grant pins GRANT_ALREADY_CONSUMED or GRANT_WRAPPER_MISMATCH at the GRANT layer and never spawns twice.
The returned immutable observation binds effect/grant/runtime digests plus exact stdout, stderr, and exit evidence digests; truncation or process uncertainty remains UNKNOWN.

@moe/runner root exports the launcher and full type closure, its plain-Node smoke succeeds, the focused runner gates exit 0, and task-task-97554aa4293e40eab56c0b642e18513a is recorded as the eventual canary consumer through the daemon dispatch task.
taskRails: TDD every behavior change; every refusal test pins the exact stable reason code and refusing layer, and generated sweeps assert a positive case count.
Use only public package roots across package boundaries; no deep imports, test-owned authority, mock-backed acceptance, or optimistic UNKNOWN upgrades.
Keep production files focused, target <=250 physical lines and split before 400; stage and commit only explicit owned paths.
Primary support target is Windows; any non-Windows path must return typed UNSUPPORTED rather than emulate Windows locking or process-tree guarantees.

implementationPlan.description: Phase 0 / RED — extend the existing production-surface launcher suite with one data-driven total-result matrix before changing implementation. Invoke the real `launchClaude` surface with valid production fixtures up to exactly one altered seam. Pin exactly twelve interpreted-result seams (resolveDuplicate, prepareRuntime, validateCommit, consumeGrant, preflight registerLock, acquireLock, openBoundary, boundary.started, post-start registerLock, boundary.completed, boundary.close, observeProcess) times two hostile fulfilled variants (Proxy/accessor trap and optimistic plain discriminator with a missing/invalid required field), assert the generated count is exactly 24 and the executed count matches, and use Promise.allSettled to prove every public call fulfills a frozen REFUSED/UNKNOWN result. Assert exact phase-local code/layer: DEPENDENCY_THROWN at LAUNCH_LOCK/ACTIVATION/GRANT, RUNTIME_THROWN/RUNTIME, LOCK_UNKNOWN/LAUNCH_LOCK for register/acquire, BOUNDARY_THROWN/LAUNCHER for open/start/completion/observation, and CLEANUP_UNKNOWN/LAUNCHER for malformed close or an unowned malformed open result. Add pinned nonzero cases for hostile entry option/dependency getters and raw thenables versus rejected/fulfilled native Promises at every awaited port, including delay and release. Assert getter/then bodies and secret/trap text never surface; pre-lock cases have exact downstream cutoffs and zero open; post-lock cases close/release exactly once; owned-boundary cases cancel as required, close, settle streams, then release; observe occurs only after close. Add a positive class/prototype-method boundary control so the tests cannot force a plain-record-only fake. Run the focused file once and record the expected red assertions against current production.

Make the injected port contract explicitly untrusted and add total pre-lock result decoding. Change ClaudeLauncherDependencies return types to `unknown`/`Promise<unknown>` at the trust boundary so the caller must parse before use. In a new focused port-results module, capture callable ports through safe data descriptors, require exact native Promises before awaiting asynchronous ports, and snapshot exact frozen local variants for duplicate delivery, runtime preparation (including every later-bound runtime field), activation commit, consumed grant, supervisor refusal, both launch-lock registrations, and acquired/releasable lease capabilities. Compose existing production parsers and closed code/layer vocabularies; reject accessors, extra/missing keys, invalid discriminants/primitives, proxies, arbitrary thenables, and malformed nested values. Never freeze/canonicalize/copy a raw value or echo its message; return fixed sanitized phase failures while preserving a well-formed delegated code/layer. Add the exact one-line LF `.js` bridge.

Add a focused boundary-result adapter that converts an untrusted open result into either a fully validated typed Windows refusal or a safe local boundary capability. For a boundary candidate, descriptor-capture and bind cancel/close cleanup methods first using a bounded prototype walk that accepts the real BrokerSession without invoking getters; only then capture exact native started/completed promises and stdout/stderr streams (do not touch unused providerStdin). Normalize every fulfilled started/completed/close Windows identity/outcome into copied frozen data with closed Windows code/layer and valid pid/creationTime/exit fields, and normalize process-observation success/refusal with parseProcessExit/parseReconciliationReference. Any malformed/reflection/thenable value yields the fixed boundary or cleanup reason for its phase; no raw object escapes. Add the exact one-line LF `.js` bridge.

Extract post-lock launch settlement into a single lifecycle owner with explicit states NO_LOCK -> LOCK_OWNED -> BOUNDARY_CLEANUP_OWNED -> STARTED_UNREGISTERED -> REGISTERED -> CLOSED -> RELEASED. From lock acquisition onward use one result accumulator and one bottom finalization path—no early returns. An exact physical-boundary refusal releases once without claiming a spawn. A boundary-like return installs cancel/close ownership before other validation; every later refusal/error/malformed result cancels when not proven completed, awaits exactly one close, settles both bounded stream captures, then attempts exactly one release. Observe/bind only exact normalized completion after close. Preserve success observation bindings for effect, activation, consumed grant, runtime digests, registration, stdout/stderr digests, exit and timestamps; keep truncation/stream/timeout/cancellation UNKNOWN semantics. Pin precedence: unproven/malformed cleanup => CLEANUP_UNKNOWN/LAUNCHER over the primary result; if cleanup settles but release is unproven => LOCK_UNKNOWN/LAUNCH_LOCK over cleanup/primary. A pending native cleanup/release Promise retains authority and does not fabricate a response. Add the exact one-line LF `.js` bridge and keep the module <=250 physical lines.

Refactor the public launcher into the ordered facade over the new decoders and lifecycle owner. Safely snapshot options/request/dependency capabilities; keep non-Windows UNSUPPORTED and malformed request behavior total. For duplicate, runtime, commit, grant, preflight registration and OS lock, invoke under containment and fully decode/copy the result before any branch or later port call; a malformed success tag never advances. Hand only validated runtime/activation/grant/registration/lease snapshots into the lifecycle module. Preserve the exact real order runtime -> commit -> one-use grant -> durable preflight -> OS lock -> shell:false Job boundary, exact typed supervisor/Windows refusals, duplicate adoption/exit behavior, and zero provider open before all prerequisites. Reduce claude-launcher.ts below 250 physical lines; keep every new production TS source <=250 (split before 400), leave the already-correct root/surface and existing launcher.js bridge unchanged, and make all existing success/refusal/concurrency/stream/cleanup tests plus the new totality matrix green.

Adversarial review — inspect the explicit-path diff and all post-lock exits as an attacker. Confirm no raw result is read, spread, frozen, canonicalized, logged, or echoed; every refusal test pins the stable code and refusing layer; every generated sweep asserts exact nonzero cardinality; no phase can open twice or skip close/release; real class-shaped boundary methods remain callable; and production line counts are <=250. Perform byte-restored mutation drills against production: bypass one descriptor decoder with a raw discriminator read (Proxy case must reject/red), allow a success-tag-only record to advance (zero-downstream assertion must red), alter code and layer independently (each exact assertion must red), remove close and remove release separately (exact counts/order must red), and let malformed completed/close data reach observation (no-observe/refusal assertion must red). Restore exact bytes after every drill and preserve all foreign work.

Final verification — after all mutations are restored, run exactly this fresh foreground command and use its real exit 0 plus runner test/typecheck counts and plain bare-root output as completion evidence: `pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test && pnpm --filter @moe/runner exec node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "const m=await import('@moe/runner');const r=await m.launchClaude({},{platform:'linux'});if(m.CLAUDE_LAUNCHER_VERSION!=='moe-claude-launcher/1'||r.truthClass!=='UNSUPPORTED'||r.code!=='CLAUDE_LAUNCH_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED'||r.layer!=='LAUNCHER')throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r));console.log(m.CLAUDE_LAUNCHER_VERSION,r.code,r.layer)"`. The runner suite must discover the expanded launcher test and the dynamic runtime-entrypoint bridge sweep must cover every new LF bridge; do not report fabricated green or hide any failure.

planningNotes.risks: Do not use `in`, spread, destructuring, optional chaining, canonicalization, deepFreeze, or direct property reads on an untrusted dependency result. A Proxy may trap reflection, but its getter/then bodies must never run or escape. Boundary validation must accept the real class-shaped BrokerSession by bounded descriptor lookup and bound method capture; naive plain-record parsing would break production. Capture cancel/close ownership before inspecting a boundary candidate's streams/promises. After a lock is acquired there must be no early return: process cleanup is attempted/settled before exactly one release, cleanup UNKNOWN overrides the primary reason, and release UNKNOWN overrides cleanup. Preserve a delegated supervisor/Windows code and layer only after its full closed shape validates; use local sanitized messages so hostile data is not echoed. A typed Windows refusal means no boundary exists; a malformed fulfilled open result without trustworthy cleanup is CLEANUP_UNKNOWN. Never-settling native Promises deliberately retain authority/lock and return nothing rather than fabricating cleanup; do not claim liveness this task cannot prove. Existing success, duplicate, exact GRANT_ALREADY_CONSUMED/GRANT_WRAPPER_MISMATCH, runtime pin, stream, timeout, cancellation, and non-Windows behavior must remain intact.
